name: queueless
description: QueueLess — clinic appointment, queue and patient-coordination platform
author: QueueLess Team

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd server && npm run lint" "cd client && npm run lint"
scripts.test: concurrently "cd server && npm test" "cd client && npm test"
